title: Virsa Singh v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Virsa Singh v. State of Punjab, AIR 1958 SC 465
content.holding: If the accused intended the bodily injury, and that injury is sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death, the third murder clause is satisfied even if death as such was not desired.
content.relevance: Foundational locus classicus on third clause of murder.
